items.title: Roger Mitchell Interview, 1972-01-19
items.q: I stopped there with Mr. Landry all the rest of it all the rest of it I was a big landry they called him up you probably heard about him

ctx.x: that well I imagine they would you I know because they used to have the the bands that turn out and they had the dance hall in the middle yeah yeah yeah well uh that was the bulls club yeah they'd have a band on one in one yard on a Tuesday night I think was that a band in one yard a band in another yard

yeah and sometimes a band in the hall really in the hall in the hall itself and it should be packed huh did they have anything in the street or across the street no yeah see I used to go to rehearsal on Tuesday nights with uh you got one there one that was a brass band oh yeah the one that I had Elizabeth and I stopped there with Mr. Landry all the rest of it all the rest of it I was a big landry they called him up you probably heard about him yeah I used to live right on the ridge street um so I used to stop out…
What did the Bulls Club like, did you pay admission to come into a dance? Oh yeah. So they were public dancing?
